rationale.zh: 本次提交修正 YAML 语法处理：在显式 key（?）之后关闭 flow sequence 时的解析行为（parser.c）。这是可接受输入格式的变化，libyaml_parser_fuzzer 对任意输入反复调用 yaml_parser_parse()，正好驱动该语法分支。harness 不对输入加任何封装或限制，构造的输入在变更后依然有效：变更前后都能编译，回放无新崩溃，新增分支被覆盖。harness 仍然充分，属于显式 input_format 阴性。
rationale.en: This commit corrects how a flow sequence is closed after an explicit key (?) in parser.c, a change to the accepted input syntax. libyaml_parser_fuzzer calls yaml_parser_parse() on arbitrary input and drives exactly this grammar branch; it adds no framing or restriction to the input, so the inputs it produces stay valid after the change: it builds before and after, replay shows no new crash, and the new branch is covered. The harness stays adequate: explicit input_format negative.
